title: Nanoscale structural evolution of Al3Sc precipitates in Al(Sc) alloys
extraction: Manually transcribed numerical table and reviewed methods; 2026-10-22
reported_error_interpretation: Reported plus/minus values are retained; they are not assumed to be 95% confidence intervals or standard deviations.
limitations: Thin-foil geometry and deformation history matter; this is not a validated bulk-part protocol.
The low-Sc alloy exhibits heterogeneous nucleation and non-spherical particles, contrary to the current bulk-nucleation spherical model.
This source is related to the upstream model parameter literature; comparison is not a blind independent holdout.
Three endpoints cannot calibrate experimental uncertainty or validate an alloy family.
